main_text.p: כשר[?] Rectum esse: Fut. יכשר Rectum fit, Eccl.11.6. Hiph. Infinit. הכשיר Dirigere, Eccl.10.10.
כישור m. Verticulum, quasi fusi Directorium, Prov.31.19. Chaldaice כשרא.
כושרות f.p. Compedes, Psalm.68.7. juxta Ab, Efram. R.Sal. Recto, opportuna tempore.

כתב Scripsit, Conscripsit, Descripsit, Inscripsit, Perscripsit, Præscripsit, Rescripsit. Præterit. כתב לכם Scripsit vobis, 2.Reg.17.37. &c, Chald. Præter. כתב Scripsit, Dan.6.25. כתבו Scripserunt, Esr.4.8. Particip. כתבין Scribentes, Dan.5.5. Fœmin. כתבה Scribens erat, ibid. Partic. Peh. כתיב Scriptum erat, Esr.5.7. Futur. נכתב Scriberemus, Esræ 5.11. Niph. Præterit. נכתב Scriptum est, Esth.3.12. Particip. נכתב Rescripta erat, Esth.8.8. Futur. יכתב Scribatur, Esth.3.9. Pih. Præter. כתבו Præscripserunt, Jesa.10.1. Particip. מכתבים Scribentibus, Scribis, ibid.

כתב m. Scriptum, Scriptura, Præscriptū, Rescriptum, Aff. ככתבם Secundum scripturam eorum, Esth.8.9. Chald. די לא כתב Cujus non Scriptura, id est, cujus mensura non est præscripta, sed indefinita, Esr.7.22. Constr. ככתב Secundum præscriptum, Esr.7.18. Fœmin. כתבה Scriptura, Dan.5.7. vel כתבא Dan.5.8.
כתל m. Paries: Aff. כתלנו Parietem nostrum, Cant. 2.9. Chald. די כתל Parietis, Dan.5.5. Plural. בכתליא In parietibus, Esr.5.8.
כתם m. Aurum-insigne: פז כתם Aurum insigne, בכתם אופיר aurum purgatissimum, Cant.5.11.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are not reproduced; consonants are copied as seen. The headword at the top (כשר) is printed in large type and read with a doubt. Some Hebrew forms in the Chaldee and Peh. entries are read from a small scan and may contain errors; the Latin is read without doubt. The text runs to the bottom of the page and the catchword "Auro" is the last printed word.
